label: hippo-20261105 · m8gd.4xlarge · S3 · 1B · public bench
description: The S3 columns of the public bench (2026-11-05, updated 2026-11-06, 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20). 16 vCPU ARM64 · 64 GiB RAM · S3 (us-east-1) · 1B rows · in-memory data caches off. Datadog BYOC 0.1.36 through the ingest API (48 shards, 20 MB/s shard limit, 30 s commit, 64 splits; 2026-11-04) and ClickHouse 26.10.2.103 (1.7 GiB part cap, 61 parts, max_threads=32; 2026-11-03), each median of 3 rounds on its own box. Load CPU is the engine only (the ingest client excluded). DuckDB 2.0 over a sorted Parquet copy on S3: separate session (2026-11-01), one run. OpenSearch 3.8.0 as a searchable snapshot on S3 (lean mapping, index sort ServiceName asc + Timestamp desc, 16 shards x 1 segment; 2026-11-19, own box, median of 3): its hot tries read its local file cache, so only its cold try compares with the other columns. Grafana Loki 3.7.9 on S3 (prefilter on, concurrency 16, 600 s cap; 2026-11-19, own box, one run): 54/56 queries finish at 600 s; excluded from the 57-query common geomean, CPU and GET sets.
